npcs.name: Canctunian Ponius
npcs.greet: The East Empire Company moves the wealth of an Empire, and I move the Company. Keep your hands clean and your ledgers cleaner.

npcs.name: Carnius Magius
npcs.greet: Factor of Raven Rock. This colony runs on ebony, and the ebony runs through me. Remember that, and we'll get along famously.

npcs.name: Falco Galenus
npcs.greet: Somebody has to keep the colony's books honest. Apparently that somebody is me, whether I like it or not.

npcs.name: Lucretia Valga
npcs.greet: Imperial Commissioner of Charters. Every company in the Empire trades by the Emperor's leave, and I decide how long that leave lasts.

relics.name: Raven Rock Ebony Sample
relics.desc: A dense, gleaming chunk from the first seam of the Raven Rock mine.

relics.name: Company-Stamped Ebony
relics.desc: Ebony bearing the East Empire Company's stamp, found in a smugglers' cave. It should never have left the warehouse.

relics.name: Carnius Magius's Letters
relics.desc: Letters arranging the sale of Company ebony to smugglers, signed in the factor's own hand.

relics.name: Company Strongbox
relics.desc: A waterlogged strongbox from the lost ship, holding the colony's quarterly accounts and its pay chest.

relics.name: Raven Rock Colony Report
relics.desc: Falco Galenus's report on the colony: the mine, the rieklings, the smugglers, the factor, and the recovered cargo.

eec_magius_exposed: These are his letters. Company ebony sold to smugglers for half its worth, and the difference in his own pocket. For years.
You think Ebonheart cares? This colony survives because I make it profitable. Guards! Our guest is leaving. Permanently.
eec_charter: A colony that pays, a factor who stole and was caught, a lost ship's accounts recovered from the Sea of Ghosts. That is more than most companies bring me.
The Company's charter is renewed for twenty years, with the Emperor's seal. Tell Ponius he owes you a great deal. I suspect he knows.

quests.title: Porter's Papers
quests.offer: I hear the Company is hiring.
quests.pitch: We always are. Our warehouse on the Ebonheart docks has been losing goods to mudcrabs, and I'm told the slaughterfish in the harbour are getting bold. Clear the docks, and you'll be on the payroll as a Porter.
quests.desc: Canctunian Ponius of the East Empire Company in Ebonheart will hire me as a Porter if I clear the docks of the creatures plaguing the Company's warehouse.

objectives.text: Clear the creatures from the Company docks
Report to Canctunian Ponius
objectives.reply: Good. Welcome to the East Empire Company, Porter. Here are your papers. Lose them and you're nobody; keep them and you're the Empire's own.

quests.outro: I joined the East Empire Company in Ebonheart as a Porter.

consequence.summary: I joined the East Empire Company in Ebonheart as a Porter.

quests.title: The Raven Rock Colony
quests.offer: Do you have work beyond the docks?
quests.pitch: The Company has founded a colony on Solstheim, at Raven Rock, around an ebony seam. The factor there, Carnius Magius, reports problems with the mine. Go and help him open it, and keep your eyes open. His reports are very short.
quests.desc: Canctunian Ponius sent me to Raven Rock, the Company's ebony colony on Solstheim, to help Factor Carnius Magius open the mine.

objectives.text: Travel to Raven Rock on Solstheim
Report to Factor Carnius Magius
objectives.topic: Ponius sent me to help open the mine.
objectives.reply: Help? Excellent. Things nest in the mine at night: rieklings, and worse. Clear them, bring me a sample of the first seam, and I'll write Ponius a glowing report.

objectives.text: Clear the creatures out of the Raven Rock mine
Take a sample from the first ebony seam
Give the ebony sample to Falco Galenus to log
objectives.reply: And he'll have it, after I've weighed it and logged it. Someone around here should. You'd be surprised how often Company ebony goes missing between the mine and the ship.

quests.outro: I helped open the Raven Rock ebony mine. Falco Galenus, the colony's clerk, hinted that Company ebony keeps going missing.

consequence.summary: I helped open the Raven Rock ebony mine. Falco Galenus, the colony's clerk, hinted that Company ebony keeps going missing.

quests.title: Rieklings and Smugglers
quests.offer: What's going wrong in Raven Rock?
quests.pitch: Two things. Rieklings from a warren to the east have been raiding the mine carts. And there's a smugglers' cave north of town where, I'm told, Company ebony turns up for sale. Deal with the first. Then look into the second, quietly.
quests.desc: Falco Galenus asked me to put an end to riekling raids on the mine carts and to look into smugglers selling Company ebony north of Raven Rock.

objectives.text: Find the riekling warren
Clear out the rieklings
Kill the riekling chief
Raid the smugglers' cave
Search the cave for Company goods
Search the smugglers' chest for papers
objectives.journal: The letters arranging each sale were signed by Carnius Magius. The factor himself was selling the colony's ebony.

objectives.text: Bring the stamped ebony to Falco Galenus
objectives.topic: The rieklings are dealt with. And the smugglers had Company ebony.
objectives.reply: I knew it. And you found letters too? Keep them. We'll need them when we face him.

quests.outro: I cleared the riekling warren and raided the smugglers' cave. The letters there prove that Factor Carnius Magius has been selling the colony's ebony.

consequence.summary: I cleared the riekling warren and raided the smugglers' cave. The letters there prove that Factor Carnius Magius has been selling the colony's ebony.

quests.title: The Factor's Ledger
quests.desc: With Carnius Magius's own letters in hand, Falco Galenus and I mean to confront the factor of Raven Rock.

objectives.text: Give the letters to Falco Galenus
objectives.topic: Here are the letters. It's time.
objectives.reply: Then let's go and see him together.

objectives.text: Defeat the factor's bought guards
Stop Carnius Magius
Speak with Falco Galenus
objectives.topic: It's over. The colony needs a new factor.
objectives.reply: It does. I'll write to Ponius tonight and keep things running until he answers. Which means I'll keep the books honest. At last.

quests.outro: I exposed and stopped Carnius Magius, the corrupt factor of Raven Rock. Falco Galenus now runs the colony.

consequence.summary: I exposed and stopped Carnius Magius, the corrupt factor of Raven Rock. Falco Galenus now runs the colony.

quests.title: Lost in the Sea of Ghosts
quests.offer: Anything else before I report to Ebonheart?
quests.pitch: One thing. The colony's last supply ship ran aground on the north coast with the quarterly accounts and the miners' pay. Wreckers have been picking at it. Bring back the strongbox, or Ebonheart will think we lost it on purpose.
quests.desc: The Raven Rock colony's supply ship ran aground on the Sea of Ghosts coast. Falco needs its strongbox, with the colony's accounts and pay chest, before wreckers find it.

objectives.text: Find the wreck on the north coast
Drive off the wreckers and the creatures around the wreck
Recover the Company strongbox
Bring the strongbox to Falco Galenus
objectives.reply: The pay chest is all here, and the accounts can be dried. The miners will cheer you tonight. Take my report to the Commissioner in Anvil; the Company's charter is up for renewal, and Ponius wants you to carry it.

quests.outro: I recovered the colony's strongbox from the wreck on the Sea of Ghosts. Falco has entrusted me with his report for the Company's charter renewal in Anvil.

consequence.summary: I recovered the colony's strongbox from the wreck on the Sea of Ghosts. Falco has entrusted me with his report for the Company's charter renewal in Anvil.

quests.title: The Charter Renewed
quests.desc: The East Empire Company's Imperial charter is up for renewal in Anvil. I am carrying Falco Galenus's report on the Raven Rock colony to the Commissioner of Charters, Lucretia Valga.

objectives.text: Travel to Anvil
Present the colony report to Commissioner Lucretia Valga
objectives.topic: The East Empire Company's report on the Raven Rock colony, Commissioner.
objectives.reply: Let me read it. Hm. A corrupt factor removed by your own people? That is unusual honesty for a company. Tell me plainly what terms you want.

objectives.text: Negotiate the terms of the charter

choices.label: Exclusive rights to Solstheim ebony, for twenty years.
choices.reply: Bold. But the report earns it. Granted, with the usual Imperial tithe.

choices.label: Fair terms, and a seat for Raven Rock's miners in the colony's council.
choices.reply: Unusual. Thoughtful. The Emperor likes colonies that don't riot. Granted.

objectives.text: Report to Canctunian Ponius in Ebonheart
objectives.topic: The charter is renewed for twenty years.
objectives.reply: Twenty years! The board will want to give you a statue. I'll settle for making you a Commissioner of the Company, and giving you a very large bonus.

quests.outro: I secured the renewal of the East Empire Company's Imperial charter in Anvil. Canctunian Ponius made me a Commissioner of the Company.

consequence.summary: I secured the renewal of the East Empire Company's Imperial charter in Anvil. Canctunian Ponius made me a Commissioner of the Company.
